The EKF augmented state approach allows to estimate the temperature field, simultaneously with the heat flux and to recover with a good accuracy other disturbance profiles with a periodic time variation.

articleTitle: Applications' Startups: Predicting Future of Smartphones Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Start-ups are fast growing entrepreneurship. They have emerged for fast propagating of new technology, products or services. In this work, a measurement study of mobile phone applications will be conducted. This study aims to reveal the popular applications' fields in smartphones world. This popularity is utilized to recommend a field for a new startup. To this end, a new model based on supervised machine learning back propagation neural network (BPNN) model is proposed. The new model is trained and utilized to predict the popularity of new applications in any application field. To facilitate our process, a web-crawler has been written to harvest smartphones' applications information from a popular Android platform's market. The crawled data consists of download count, applications categories and users' reviews. These data has been fed to train the proposed model. Our results show that the model has been trained with a mean square error root approximately 0.002, which show the relation between download count and application category. This relation reflects the popularity of some categories in smartphone applications' market.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Actuator Fault Estimation Applied to a Hydrographic Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Unknown input estimation have a major importance in real-time monitoring, diagnosis and fault-tolerance control. Consequently, this paper concentrates on state estimation for nonlinear system where a part of its inputs is unknown. In particular, the problem is oriented towards an experiential application for laboratory three tank system affected by actuator faults. Our objective is to perform the fault detection (FE) by the synthesis and the implementation of the unknown input observer (UIO). Simulation and experimental results confirm the performance of the suggested observer.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant NCS for Pharmaceutical Process
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: The use of Ethernet as a communication protocol for Networked Control Systems (NCS) is gaining interest in the automation community. The applications of such protocol range from industrial control to automotive and aerospace. The demand on using new architectures to guarantee system tolerance to faults and failures of single or multiple nodes, is increasing. Such system design decreases production downtime and increases profitability. An NCS Fault-Tolerant system model is proposed in this study for pharmaceutical tablet production. It will be shown that the introduced architecture can accommodate for the failure of more than one controller node in the production scheme.

articleTitle: Diagnosis for lipschitz nonlinear system with sliding mode observer and virtual sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper proposes a scheme for designing a robust sliding mode observer and a virtual sensor for uncertain Lipschitz nonlinear system with actuator and sensor faults are considered. First, a transformation of states and outputs is proposed to divide the original system into two subsystems in order to isolate the sensor faults, such that the first subsystem is affected by actuator faults and the second subsystem is subjected only to sensor faults. Then, we design a single SMO to estimate all stats and simultaneous actuator and sensor faults. Moreover, we use a technique called virtual sensor to replace a failed, missing or corrupted sensor to estimate and recover the sensor faults. Then, An illustrative example based on robotic manipulator model is conducted to verify the proposed approach effectiveness.

articleTitle: Auto-Organiser Neural Network Application for Ultrasound Computed Tomographic Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Image classification still be a crucial topic of interest in the field of medical imaging diagnostic. In this paper, we have used a new Ultrasonic Computed Tomography (USCT) prototype giving us USCT bone images. However, given images are difficult to interpret and to classify. As a solution, an Auto Organiser Neural Network has been proposed to classify them automatically into pathologic bone images and healthy images. As a result, we have achieved an accuracy of 94.2% and an excellent value of gradient descent. Obtained results outperforms related works.

articleTitle: A graph model-based fault detection framework for structural analysis of complex systems
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper deals with a new causal graph-based fault detection and isolation framework. The Causal Ordering Graph is herein used to overcome difficulties of modeling dynamic large-scale systems due to both qualitative and quantitative reasoning. For the fault monitoring tasks, the generic model in natural causality is enable to infer systematically redundancy relationships. Compared with classical graphical tools-based residual signals, the developed scheme allows to get the better of problems related to sensor dualizations, aspects of derivative causality, the presence of algebraic loops and non-invertible constraints. At last, the RLC electrical system is presented as an illustrative example.

articleTitle: Design of parametric estimation algorithm for Hammerstein-Wiener mathematical models
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this document, we study the nonlinear stochastic system represented by Hammerstein- Wiener mathematical models. The Recursive Extended Least Squares (RELS) based on fuzzy technique is also used to estimate the parameters of the considered model. Moreover, nonlinear hydraulic process simulations are introduced to evaluate the efficiency of the developed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of RCS and Evaluation of PO Approximation's Accuracy for Simple Targets
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper describes the Radar Cross Section (RCS) analysis and prediction for simple target shapes such as circular flat plate, triangular flat plate, ellipsoid, sphere, ellipsoid, truncated cone and cylinder. This paper also discusses the accuracy of physical optics (PO) approximation in measuring the far field monostatic radar cross section of different simple objects varying in size using the Matlab Programming to simulate the output graphs, and the results were compared to a more exact data obtained by CST Microwave Studio Simulation software which uses asymptotic solver in calculating RCS for these objects.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of lightweight Block Ciphers in soft-core processor
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) and RFID devices are essential parts of the new information technology generation. They are mostly characterized by their limited power and computing resources. In order to ensure their security under computing and power constraints, a number of lightweight cryptography algorithms has emerged. This paper outlines the performance analysis of six lightweight blocks crypto ciphers with different structures - LED, PRESENT, HIGHT, LBlock, PICCOLO and TWINE on a LEON3 open source processor. We have implemented these crypto ciphers on the FPGA board using the C language and the LEON3 processor. Analysis of these crypto ciphers is evaluated after considering various benchmark parameters like throughput, execution time, CPU performance, AHB bandwidth, Simulator performance, and speed. These metrics are tested with different key sizes provided by each crypto algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Isolation on a Five-level PWM Inverter applied to the electric vehicle system
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this paper, we suggest an electric vehicle (EV) system. It is based on the rotor-field-oriented control of the induction motor (IM). The IM is feed by the five-level H-Bridge inverter. The Phases Disposition Carrier- Pulse Width Modulation PDC-PWM is used to command the multilevel inverter. The system reliability and stability is very important, therefore, we propose a fault detection and isolation system in the five-level H-Bridge inverter applied to the electric transportation system. Recently, in the high-power applications, the five-level inverter is largely used owing to its typical performance. Nevertheless, it is possible that a fault affects this electronic equipment and causes damage to the system. Hence, the main purpose of this paper is to detect and to locate the faults then replaces the damaged equipment with another one. In this context, the fault diagnosis of the H-bridge multilevel inverter system is based on an implemented algorithm to localize the defection and isolate it by replacing the defected cell with a rescue cell. This localization is based on the current evaluation, due to its value and THD percentage, the defected cell can be easily detected, and thus, the correction can be quick and effective. The proposed algorithm is implemented by means of MATLAB/ Simulink in order to realize the needed corrections.

articleTitle: Experimental and simulation study of a stand-alone photovoltaic system with storage battery
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: The photovoltaic energy is considered as the suitable and sustainable source of energy for generating electricity. This paper focused on the experimental validation compared to the simulation ones for a stand-alone photovoltaic system. It based on PV panel/battery/inverter with AC load and charge controller. Our PV panel utilizes the artificial light source for generating a dc energy suitable for charging the 12V battery and supplying an AC load. Besides, we develop a mathematical model or topology model of the PV panel and all other components. To this end and reacting to that need, the results obtained with the system, as well as the experimental of a prototype of the laboratory, will be given.

articleTitle: Spectral Response and Efficiency of a Gearbox - SEIG system involved in Wind Turbine Application
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Wind turbine is among the renewable electrical energy sources, this source of electricity raises its importance from its continuity and its cleanliness. This justifies the importance of its reliability. In this way, gearbox of wind turbine must be monitored. In this paper, simulated wind system is implemented in laboratory, vibration and generator stator current are sampled from sensors and analyzed through FFT techniques. Resulting spectrums are investigated in order to characterize a healthy gearbox before introducing a tooth fault. Differences between theoretical and practical characteristic frequencies of the gearbox can affect the spectrums interpretation and consequently the diagnosis decision cannot be efficient. This difference is caused by losses in practical frequencies. The present work gives a formulation of the gearbox transmission efficiency to determine the origin of the losses in gearbox practical frequencies.

articleTitle: Backstepping Control of Nonlinear Uncertain System Using Sliding Mode Differentiator
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper deals with a sliding mode differentiator based-backstepping control applied to a nonlinear uncertain dynamic system. The differentiator is integrated in order to estimate the tracking error derivatives. The principal goals of this method are ameliorating control performance and minimizing sensors number. Two types of tracking error are studied: a classical form and a PID form. Simulation results prove the control technique robustness against parametric uncertainties for both types of error tracking.

articleTitle: The Experimental Investigation of Mobile Networks Using Radio over Fiber Solutions
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: The continuous pursuit to improve the cellular communication networks lead to fit the huge demand of high data rates for the users. This makes the networks operators came up with new techniques to continue in these improvements. The Fiber to The Antenna (FTTA) and Fiber To the Base Station (FTTB) techniques considered the suitable and best solutions in the world of modern communications, characterized by several features that gives a very positive addition to the existing networks, that is because the fiber optic technology has very wide bandwidth, higher data rates, very low power loss. It is the main component of FTTA and FTTB solutions as well as it is avoid many defects which causing several prospective problems such as complexities in installation, limited development and costly consumption. When the comparison had done between the traditional system and the developed system. The differences was clear and large among them in favor of the developed system, here is also explain the reason of the fiber optic technologies are used efficiently in 4G networks, through reviews the advantages, challenges and the ways to overcome it in the FTTA and FTTB solutions..

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Observer for a Class of Nonlinear Time-Delay Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this paper, we will pose a state estimation method for a class of nonlinear uncertain time-delay systems using an SMO. Thus, we will report a new method of SMO synthesis, where the fundamental notion is to mix the SMO perception with an adequate alternative of a Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional with LMI optimization. This way is old, but our contribution to operate these procedures to get another SMO that differs from further efforts in this class of the studied systems and, in particular, uncertain time-delay systems with lipschitzian nonlinearities, with a view to guarantee the stability of the dynamics of error of estimation and to determine the gains this observer. A model is designed to explain the adequacy of the approaches considered.

articleTitle: Bond Graph Modelling and Sliding Mode Control of Convective Drying of Thin Layer Apple
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this work, we have developed a mathematical model of the convective drying process of natural products, showing the main phenomena observed during drying, that are heat and mass transfers. This phenomenon was examined by applying the pseudo bond graph methodology. Experimental drying tests were make on apple slices and a comparison between experimental and theoretical results was performed to validate the developed model. Also a sliding mode control applied to this drying process has been tested by simulations.

articleTitle: Robust Tracking Controller for Quadrotor Based on Flatness and High Gain Observer
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper proposes a robust tracking controller based on the state estimation for a quadrotor. Using the differential flatness theory, it is demonstrated that the quadrotor model can be changed to a linearized form which facilitate the creation of a state feedback controller. Since some state vectors of the obtained linearized model cannot be measured directly, a high gain observer is implemented to estimate them. After that, utilizing the estimation state obtained by the latter observer, a new guidance law is developed for the quadrotor enabling a robust tracking to the desired trajectory despite the existence of unmesurable states. The numerical simulation of the quadrotor system is done in order to evaluate the performance of the robust tracking control scheme.

articleTitle: A filtered high gain observer for a nonlinear hybrid system: the Alternating Activated Sludge Process
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this paper, a filtered high gain observer is developed for a nonlinear hybrid system: the Alternating Activated Sludge Process. The design procedure is based on the combination between classical high gain observer design and the idea of using linear filters on the observation error. It is shown that the designed observer allows the estimation of the unmeasured states (the biodegradable substrate and the ammonia concentration) despite the presence of measurement noise. In order to highlight the effectiveness of the proposed estimation approach, a comparison with the classical high gain observer is performed based on numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Measurements and Calculations of the Electromagnetic Radiation in Tripoli
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: The aim from this work is to investigate the radiation power from mobile base stations by measuring the power density of selected base station on schools of local communication networks in Tripoli, The measurement of radiated power density from mobile phone base station antennas conducted on which mobile phone base stations installed; and then compare the measured data with Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) guidelines, to ensure power radiation level radiated by base station antennas over these schools is within the level of SAR and calculate the safe distance from chosen base stations, The base stations have been chosen according to the location, frequency, gain (G), power (P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>), and the company. That companies under study are: Libyana and Almadar companies.

articleTitle: Fault estimation based fault tolerant control design for Linear parameter varying system
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: A fault estimation (FE) and fault-tolerant control (FTC) conception is suggested for LPV systems with actuator defect and disturbance. To estimate simultaneously the actuator fault and system states, a Sliding Mode Observer (SMO)is conceived. Using the estimates, an FTC controller is developed to guarantee robust stability of the closed-loop system. Via H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> optimization, the parameters of SMO and controller are obtained with linear matrix inequality (LMI) formulation. The FTC performance is illustrated using an example with actuator faults as well as disturbance.

articleTitle: A new techno-economic analysis of fuel cell in Photovoltaic pumping system
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Photovoltaic pumping technology is considered the most sustainable and economical application for providing water for irrigation. In this work, a new sizing algorithm of a photovoltaic pumping system, composed of photovoltaic, fuel cell, electrolyzer and hydrogen tanks, is presented. Deficiency of power supply probability and total net present cost are considered as the objectives of the optimization procedure and the decision variables are the power of the photovoltaic pannel, electrolyzer power, fuel cell power and hydrogen tank volume. We conclude that fuel cell technology is competitive with batteries. The storage of electrical energy with a hydrogen chain deserves to be tested and studied.

articleTitle: A Multi Objective Analytical Approach for Optimal Association of Photovoltaic Units to Shunt Capacitor Banks inside a Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: The present research work aims to enhance the voltage stability, ameliorate the system power factor, and reduce the total power loss, through optimal allocation of PV units and shunt capacitor banks (SCB) inside a distribution network. The proposed algorithm identifies firstly the most sensible buses to voltage instability were PV units are to be installed, then the optimal PVs sizes are fixed by minimizing the total power losses. It is worth highlighting that the PVs allocation process requires only the base case load flow results, which permits to escape exhaustive computation. Further, the SCB unit sizing is established to provide a better power factor and its appropriate position is assigned to the bus providing maximum loss saving. The suggested method has been tested on the 33 bus IEEE distribution network and its efficiency is discussed based on simulation results.

articleTitle: A Discrete Integral Sliding Mode Controller for I/O Nonlinear Hammerstein systems
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Blocks oriented models are the most structure used to describe nonlinear systems. These models are composed with two blocks: the first is a nonlinear part and the second is a linear part. Hammerstein model is one of block oriented models. Recently, the design of sliding mode control (SMC) in discrete-time for nonlinear systems is done using this structure. However, SMC suffer from a major problem: the chattering phenomenon. So, this work proposes to synthesize an integral sliding function to control nonlinear systems using Input/Output (I/O) Hammerstein structure in order to remove the chattering phenoenon. The effenciency of the proposed DISMC in terms of chattering phenomenon minimisation was verified by a simulation example and results are given at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Second order sliding mode control of a low pressure discharge lamp
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper presents the sliding mode control of a low pressure discharge lamp used for water disinfection. The chattering problem in the classic sliding mode is solved using super-twisting algorithm and reliable results are given to prove the interest of high order sliding mode controller for complex and nonlinear systems.

articleTitle: Optimal C-RAN Clustering in 5G context based on Memetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: To meet the 5G requirements in terms of high capacity and enhanced quality of service, the Cloud Radio Access Network (C-RAN) relies on the network densification and coordination. The main idea behind the C- RAN is to split the base station into two parts: the first component is the Remote Radio Head (RRH) which will be responsible for all Radio transmissions and the second one is the Base Band Unit (BBU) which will be responsible for the processing and control. Only the RRH will be densified to offer more capacity. The processing resources will be pooled and clustered so that many RRHs will be managed by one BBU pool which will reduce the related CAPEX and OPEX of the network's deployment, operation and maintenance. The main goal of this paper is to propose an optimized clustering algorithm able to improve interference management between BBU clusters and decrease the network mobility signaling cost. In this work, we will be interested by the implementation and optimization of local search algorithm (Tabu Search) and evolution algorithm (Genetic Algorithm) as well as the combination of both methods in order to enhance the convergent solution.

articleTitle: Sliding mode navigation control of an omnidirectional mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to navigate an omnidirectional mobile robot from an initial point to a desired point with predefined direction with minimal error. For this reason, we apply the sliding mode control. Fundamentally, the conventional sliding mode control uses a switching control law to drive the nonlinear system trajectory onto a sliding surface in the system state space and to keep it on this surface. This leads to a chattering phenomenon. In order to overcome this problem, we develop the sliding mode control with a proportional integral (PI) tuning. Simulation results show the performances and the improvement of the second approach compared to the first one.

articleTitle: Parameterized Design of a Coiled Rotor Synchronous Generator Structure Dedicated to Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this study is presented a design methodology and a sizing program of a coiled rotor synchronous generator with axial flux dedicated to wind energy conversion system equivalent to a permanent magnet one offering the advantages of a variable excitation and a lower cost. The generator is designed jointly by the analytical method offering the advantages of compatibility with large- scale optimization approaches and the finite element method for verifying and increasing the accuracy of the analytical computation. This study essentially involves the design and modeling phase of the generator dissociated from the wind system and then by the phase of its integration to the wind system as part of a comparative study between the conceived generator and its equivalent. The global models of the two chains are implemented under the Matlab_Simulink simulation environment for performance and efficiency analysis.

articleTitle: Path Tracking Of a Mobile Robot Based On Interval Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: One important problem in autonomous navigation of a robot is following an unknown path. Over the past several years, numerous studies and researches had considered the path tracking issue. Alternative methods have been developed to overcome this problem. This paper proposes a method based on Interval Analysis. The problem is then formulated as a constraint satisfaction problem where a simple algorithm is applied in order to contract the solution. This technique yields a guaranteed and robust online estimation of the robot. Simulation results on a car-like robot corroborate the efficiency of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Semulation of Leishmaniasis Epidemiology in Libya Using Agent Based Modelling
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Epidemics control is a continues struggle. In this paper is an attempt to model and then simulate an epidemiological disease known as Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (CL), which is currently affecting large communities in Libya. The model is developed to facilitate the Agent Based Models (ABM) as one of the many tools applied for epidemiological management. Validation of the model is considered by comparing the model's behavior with a trend of field data used by Libyan authorities. The methodology used for describing and designing CL model is derived from nature of the disease mechanisms. The ABM model involves three types of agents: Human, Rodent and Sand-fly. Each agent has its own properties. Additionally, global model parameters are used for following the human infection processes. Several experiments are given for illustrating the model performance, and monitor the number of people infected. Simulation results show that active human agents are more vulnerable to sand-fly bites, and infection rate is increasing or decreasing dependent on number of sand-fly vectors, number of host rodents, and human population awareness level.

articleTitle: Tracking Control Design for Fractional Systems with Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Fault tolerant control has been an important subject for many researchers. Nevertheless, there are few works dealing with fractional systems up to now and especially in presence of time delay. In this context, this paper proposes a tracking control design for fractional order system with time delay. The aim is to control the system in order to obtain the same performances of a time delay fractional reference model. The controller parameters are computed in both nominal and faulty functioning in case the state is available and unavailable for measurement. The efficiency of the proposed method is illustrated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Fuzzy supervisor for neural emulation of MIMO nonlinear processes
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper present a fuzzy supervisor for neural emulator of nonlinear MIMO processes to guarantee good performances of the neural emulator by its convergence rapidity and its accurent representation. In this proposed case, without initializing the parameter and online adaptation, both are needed. Numerical simulations are realized to clarify the performances improvement relatively to the classical case where the starting term is necessary.

articleTitle: Fuzzy intelligent management of inter-exchanged energy between standalone photovoltaic systems
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Renewable off-grid electricity supply is one alternative that has gained attention, mainly with areas lacking a grid system. The photovoltaic installation can provide more power than the load need at a given time, especially for sunny days. This extra energy should be transferred to neighbouring systems with lack in energy production. The aim of this paper is to present fuzzy switchboxes for interconnecting nearby off-grid photovoltaic systems for exceeding energy exchange. Energy management results prove the accuracy of this methodology to ensure surplus energy share.

articleTitle: FEA-based performances evaluation of three permanent magnet machines for traction application
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Traction motors play a significant role in electric vehicles' applications. With great power density and efficiency, permanent magnet (PM) machines have been progressively more applied in a lot of electrified vehicles. In this work, three different topologies of synchronous permanent magnet machines (SPMM) for traction application are comparatively investigated using finite element analysis (FEA) tool. These machines include surface-mounted PM (SPM), conventional interior PM (IPM) and V-shape PM rotor configurations with distributed windings in the stator. All machines have the same stator. The investigated characteristics include the air gap flux density, the magnetic field distribution and the iron losses. IPM machines are compared in terms of the cogging torque. The simulation results show that each topology has its advantages and its drawbacks. Particularly, the SPM machine is considered the best one.

articleTitle: Software Defined Networking
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper investigates the notion of software-defined networking (SDN), whose southbound interface can be applied through the OpenFlow protocol. The aim of this study is to discover the SDN architecture and the OpenFlow standard in some details. In addition, to look at implementing their tools on the oil company network. The simulation is done using mixing between a network emulator Mininet and Ryu controller with using python scripts.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Wind Farm in Tarhuna Region with Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper gives a design steps for wind farm in Tarhuna region, and the effect of this designed wind farm on Tarhuna electrical network. Ten Wind turbines have been compared, and the suitable Turbine for this side were chosen based on the largest capacity factor achieved. The design of this wind farm are based on the real data of wind speed for a height of 10m, 20m, and 40m by using anemometer device, these data were taken from the Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAOL). The wind data is analyzed by using Windographer software to found out wind speeds in the site for different high levels and the replication of wind speed in every month. In addition, the suitable direction of wind turbine in which the turbine facing the max speed of wind was determined. The designed wind farm was connected to the Tarhuna substation in order to determine max power should be provided by wind farm, that should not affected on the voltage level of Tarhuna substation, and the loading in the lines and transformer, as well as the short circuit levels, by calculating load flow, and short circuit analysis using NEPLAN software. In addition, economic study of this project is perform for 20 years. The preliminary analysis of this simulation results showed that the project is electrically and economically beneficial for the electrical energy system in Tarhuna, and Libyan network.

articleTitle: Review on optimization algorithms for plug in hybrid electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this study, Vehicle to grid (V2G) application is considered as an important solution to minimize the CO2 emission, as well as its ability to involve the utilization of renewable energy and recovers the limitation of fossil energy. In this context, the plug in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) have attracted the attention of researchers and industries due to its various advantages especially it's utilization as a good interface on the V2G application all over the world. This paper includes an introduction of various vehicle architecture and the formulation of total cost of ownership (TCO) presented during the owning period of the vehicle. We are also interested on the different approaches and algorithms used for optimal design of PHEV in literature to optimize the TCO.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Ant Lion Optimizer to solve the Dynamic Economic Dispatch Problem with Valve Point Effect
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In present work, the MOALO applied to solve dynamic economic dispatch problems with valve point effect and with and without loss of transmission. The proposed method repository in first used to search for optimal solutions of the generated powers and then calculate the cost function. The dynamic problem of economic distribution (DEDP) is a major problem in power systems. This consists of a valve point effect, a load, a power balance and generator constraints. This method was applied to two test systems with 5 and 10 generators with different constraints. The results obtained are compared to those found in the literature. All simulations are performed on the MATLAB-Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Coordinated Motion Control of a Nonholonomic Mobile Manipulators Using Self-Tuning Fuzzy Logic Control
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In this paper, a dynamic trajectory tracking controller is proposed for controlling a redundant mobile manipulator system. Firstly, the kinematic and dynamic models of the system under nonholonomic constraint is formulated. Then, a dynamic control algorithm is given by decoupling the overall movement of the system in task space movement and null space movement. The control of the two sub-spaces can be designed independently such that the priority is always given to the primary task. In order to enhance the performance of the system, a self-tuning fuzzy PD controller is used to control the main task and a Backstepping based fuzzy dynamic control is utilized to control the internal motion. Simulations are conducted to show the high-precision, the small control effort and the good robustness of the proposed intelligent algorithm in comparison with a conventional dynamic redundancy controller.

articleTitle: Observer design with mixed continuous and multirate sampled outputs involving multiple time-varying delays
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: A high gain observer is proposed for a class of multi-output uniformly observable systems involving external disturbances. Each output may be available with a delay under a mixed form, i.e. continuously in time over some time intervals and only at sampling instants over other ones. Moreover, each output is associated to a sampling partition and a delay without assuming any relation between the considered sampling partitions, nor the output delays. The corner stone of the proposed observer design consists in the consideration of an appropriate observer gain issued from the resolution of a linear Delay Differential Equation (DDE) which accounts for all the sampling partitions as well as the presence of the output delays. It is worth noticing that the proposed observer has the same dimension as the system whenever the output delays are relatively small. The convergence analysis related to the proposed observer is performed thanks to a comprehensive Lyapunov approach under a well-defined condition on the sum of the upper bound of the sampling partition diameters and of the upper bound of the time-varying outputs delays. The performance of the proposed observer and its main properties are highlighted through an example dealing with a flexible joint robot arm.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Tracking Control of a Standalone PV Pumping System based on an Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper traits the modeling of a PV pumping system composed of an induction motor (IM) connected to a centrifugal pump and subject to variable solar irradiations. A Maximum Power Point Tracker based on Perturb and Observe (P&O) algorithm is applied for the objective of ameliorating the performance of the pumping system. A Takagi-Sugeno (TS) fuzzy controller, based on a reference tracking TS model, is implemented to the IM. First, A mathematical model in the synchronous d-q frame rotating is developed, that is later converted to a TS model with field-oriented control strategy. After that, basing on the H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup> performance, a fuzzy state feedback controller is established to insure the reference trajectory tracking, provided by the TS reference model. The fuzzy observer is applied to estimate the rotor flux which is inaccessible. The control law developed is based on the minimization of the disturbances effect on the tracking error according to the H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup> criterion. The control strategy is based on the Lyapunov theorem to guarantee the trajectory tracking performance. Thus, stability conditions, the controller and observer gains are formulated as linear matrix inequalities (LMI). At last, simulation is done to illustrate the tracking performance of the developed T-S tracking controller.

articleTitle: An Overview of blind Equalization Algorithms for Digital Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: A main topics in modern wireless communication systems is the development of equalization algorithms for different single-carrier modulations. This paper lists the most important blind equalization techniques for single-carrier modulations. A detailed study of some of these most used approaches in the literature is presented, in particular their principles, characteristics, operating conditions, advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Near-field Wireless Power Transfer is a promising approach to Power-up Active Implants
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: Since the 20th century, portable electronic devices such as laptops, cell phones, tablets and medical implants have emerged our daily life. All these devices require energy to operate properly. Batteries' short lifetimes that supply these devices are the major disadvantage for their good use. The problem becomes even more delicate when it comes to medical implants, caused by the surgical operations necessity to replace battery. Therefore, Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) has been considered as a promising solution to overcome any health or side complications. Implants provide substantial improvement in healthcare by helping to manage diseases and save innumerable lives of patients anywhere, anytime over the word. In particular, active implants (AI) are power hungry, so they need electrical energy to operate properly and efficiently. By inspecting the literature, it is clear that near-field magnetic WPT approach dominates transcutaneous applications. For that, this paper explains the general concept of implants and it illustrates selected applications of WPT in AI.

articleTitle: Implementation of MPC control for quadruple-tank system using LabView: A decentralized approach
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This work presents an implementation of a Decentralized Model Predictive Controller (DecMPC) using the Control Design and Simulation module of LabView software. DecMPC is applied to quadruple tank process to validate the effectiveness of the design. The LabVIEW module provides an easy to use application development environment designed specifically for engineers and scientists. It also offers powerful features that make it easy to connect with hardware and software.

articleTitle: Grid-connected photovoltaic panel via an inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: This paper presents the modeling for a grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) and the generated power regulation considering the solar irradiation variations and of the temperature. This connection was realized through an inverter followed by a filter to improve the produced energy quality. A Mamdani fuzzy algorithm based Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) control technique was proposed to optimize the value of the voltage of the photovoltaic generator whatever the climatic conditions. This controller enables to track the maximum power point (MPP), thereby increasing the produced energy by the PV generator to supply it to the distribution network. A control strategy based on the Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy method was detailed to calculate the command law in order to control the DC/AC inverter. The resolution of linear matrix inequalities (LMI) was used to calculate the fuzzy controller gains. The H-infinite method was applied to reduce the effect of the perturbation. In order to demonstrate the performance of the control strategy of the proposed system, we were used the Matlab-Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Shared energy algorithm and parameters influence on multi-sources and multi-consumers smart microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 19th International Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (STA)
abstract: In almost electrical grid application, we found the “energy management” term which ensure many benefits in order to ameliorate the control of energy and also to streamlining the use from the level of production, distribution to the energy consumption. In this paper, we will condense our work in some particular case when we will explain the “sharing energy” concept in electrical grid application characterized by multi-sources and multi-consumers. To ensure an optimal management of electrical energy, we develop a modified “demand side management algorithm” which allows terminal consumers to plan the daily consumption of their own households in order to reduce the monthly and annual cost and avoid breakdowns caused by overloads created by the consumption peaks. It associates, finally, to each customer the appropriate and suitable daily planning throughout the entire year which generates the minimum cost while respecting the renewable production and the dynamic pricing specified by nonrenewable source of the utility company. The main goal, is to minimize the total cost of electrical energy, can be guaranteed by studying intensely the parameters that influence the cost that guide us to the ideal and supreme combination of them.
